name: Eastwall Gate
summary: At Stratholme’s eastern wall, Eastwall Gate offers a way into the ruined city. It lies in northern Eastern Plaguelands, apart from the chaos at the main gates.

sections.title: The Back Door to Ruin
sections.body: Eastwall Gate cuts through Stratholme’s eastern fortifications. The main entrance opens onto King’s Square, but this barred passage leads to Elders’ Square near the steps of Alonsus Chapel. From there, you can enter the city’s depths without passing the front barricades or the undead lines.

sections.title: Through the Iron Lattice
sections.body: Heavy ironwork seals Eastwall Gate. The Key to the City, found inside Stratholme, opens it, and an infiltrator skilled enough can pick its masterwork locks. A mechanical lever on the inner wall raises the portcullis so allies can follow.

faq.q: Where does the Eastwall Gate lead?
faq.answer: Eastwall Gate opens into Elders’ Square in ruined Stratholme, near Alonsus Chapel.

faq.q: How can the gate be opened?
faq.answer: Eastwall Gate is locked. The Key to the City, found inside Stratholme, opens it, or an expert rogue can pick the lock. A lever inside raises the portcullis.

faq.q: Why would adventurers use this entrance over the main gate?
faq.answer: Eastwall Gate lets strike teams bypass the infested front streets and enter near Elders’ Square. From there, they can reach particular quarters of the city more quickly.

faq.q: Can you open the gate from the inside?
faq.answer: Yes. A lever on Stratholme’s side raises Eastwall Gate and lets others through without a key.

angles.text: As a rogue, you need masterful lockpicking to open Eastwall Gate without the Key to the City.
As a paladin, you emerge near Alonsus Chapel, a holy sanctuary amid the Scourge’s ashes and horrors.
